parent_objective: audit current-sim measured execution completeness and raw outcome distribution before interpretation
blocked_by: M2174 measured execution must be audited before comparison design or repair
supersedes: direct profile ranking from raw aggregates

public_gates: M2175 must audit M2174 summary and aggregates without rerun
M2175 must classify execution completeness and raw outcome support
M2175 must decide next route without ranking controller families
M2175 must not claim paper-level evidence or finite-window vs GRU verdict
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits full 320-cell measured execution output and chooses comparison or repair route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2174 completeness gates are not audited
stop if raw aggregates are used to rank profiles
stop if outcome support is too low for comparison but route ignores repair
stop if audit claims paper-level result
fallback_plan: route to denominator-backed comparison protocol if comparison-ready
route to outcome/task repair if offtrack or collision dominance blocks comparison
route to synthesis if the branch has reached a broader verdict point
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2174 measured execution result requires audit

admission_evidence: M2174 writes full episode rows and aggregates
allowed_updates: M2175 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for comparison protocol, repair, or synthesis

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2175 audits measured outcomes but does not run history-necessity interventions.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2175.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If outcomes are low-support or offtrack-dominated, route to repair or task-quality work instead of ranking profiles.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns new M2174 closed-loop data into a route decision
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether the current-sim panel is comparison-ready or needs repair, but cannot decide final ranking
must_synthesize_if: M2175 needs another measured execution rerun
M2175 would directly claim a winner

hypothesis: The M2174 measured execution can be audited into a clear next route without overclaiming raw aggregate profile differences.
success_criteria: no rerun ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: raw aggregate values are turned into profile ranking
decision_rule: M2175 passes if it audits M2174 and chooses a comparison/repair/synthesis route without ranking or paper-level claims.
